rules:
Make the fixed goal-level split (v1). Run once; the output file is the source of truth.

Rules (2026-11-10, Leo):
  - Split by attacker GOAL (all 17 user cases of a goal stay together), pooling direct-harm (dh) and
    data-stealing stage 1 (ds).
  - Every goal already touched by any pre-GPU check goes to DEV (listed in USED_IN_PRECHECKS, found by scanning
    every log on 2026-11-10 15:45: 17 dh goals, 0 ds goals).
  - TEST = 6 dh + 6 ds goals drawn (seed 0) from untouched goals. Locked: only read with RL_REDTEAM_FINAL_EVAL=1.
  - DEV additionally gets 4 ds goals (seed 0) so dev covers both sets. Everything else is TRAIN.
  - Canary = 16 fixed dev tasks (seed 0) for the every-25-steps check during training.
